title: arc_os model manifest
description: Describes one GGUF model (ADR-0012, knowledge-os.md section 7). It is the `model` object of a model .arcpkg manifest. arc-llm reads it to load the model and to check that the machine has the RAM.

roles.description: Roles this model can fill. The user picks which installed model fills each role (model-roles.schema.json).

file.description: The GGUF weights, relative to the model's install directory.

quantization.description: GGUF quantization type as llama.cpp names it (e.g. Q4_K_M, Q8_0, F16).

ram_mb.description: RAM the model needs loaded at context_length, in MiB. Install refuses or warns when the machine cannot give it (ADR-0012).

chat_template.description: Chat template (Jinja, as in the GGUF metadata). Required for models that can fill `chat`, `router` or `expert:*`.

embedder.description: For `embed` models: the embedder id that names a pack's vectors/<embedder-id>/ folder, and the vector size. A pack's vectors work only with this embedder.
